class.name: HTMLCanvasGradient
class.brief_description: A linear color gradient used by an HTML canvas 2D context.
class.description: Created by [method HTMLCanvasRenderingContext2D.create_linear_gradient]. Add color stops in any order; duplicate offsets retain their insertion order.

method.name: add_color_stop
method.description: Adds a stop at an offset from [code]0.0[/code] to [code]1.0[/code]. Color may be a Godot [Color] or CSS color string. Returns [constant OK] on success.
